notes: Wide landscape crop, straight-on, one shelf of Enid Blyton paperbacks in a white cupboard under dim, greenish indoor light; the photo is soft and noisy (2560x917) and the top-right stack is in shadow. English throughout. Famous Five volumes 1-21 stand in order with the volume title in small type at the foot of each spine; the numbers read clearly and most volume titles read at full size, so they are labelled by volume; volumes 13 and 16 are in partial because their small type is too blurred to confirm beyond the number. The Secret Seven stands three times (two copies upside down in the stack) and is labelled once by its printed title. The Award Publications 'Secret' books are labelled by their printed titles (The Secret of Spiggy Holes, The Secret of Killimooin). Left out: the pale spine on top of the stack (title unreadable), the yellow book behind Adventures of the Six Cousins (only a cover picture shows), the four slim green and blue spines right of the Famous Five run (Secret Seven series titles too blurred), and the two blue Award spines between Those Dreadful Children and The Put-Em-Rights (title too dark to read).
